summary:
## Goal
- Implement Go-side calls on existing Tengo `CompiledFunction` objects (`CompiledFunction.Call`) so functions/closures from script globals, nested arrays/maps, source-module exports, and Go callback arguments execute identically to in-script calls (globals, imports, captures, variadics, recursion, error formatting).
- Ensure returned closures/composites stay callable; cloned instances and callables assigned into another instance keep isolated state (captures snapshotted at transfer time, globals resolving against destination instance, recursive isolation through arrays/maps).
- Work on branch `feature/callable-instance-isolation` from master; commit, push to origin; do NOT overwrite existing commits already on that remote branch.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Keep the public entrypoint on the current callable objects (i.e., `Call` on `*CompiledFunction`).
- Must preserve existing remote WIP commits on `origin/feature/callable-instance-isolation` (user: "Don't overwrite the commits that are already on that branch").
- Repo: `/app` (tengo v2), origin = `/srv/git/tengo.git`; all tests + `-race` must pass.
- Final step must be exactly: `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` (no other command combined).

## Progress
### Done
- Explored codebase: vm.go, objects.go, compiler.go, script.go, bytecode.go, symbol_table.go, docs, tests.
- New file `callable.go`: `callRuntime` struct (mu, fileSet, constants, globalNames, globals, globalIndexes, maxAllocs, owner, shadow *shadowGlobals, adopted map), `shadowGlobals` (mutex-protected), `CompiledFunction.Call`, `bindValue`/`bindValueCtx`/`bindDeep`/`bindPointer`, `adoptValue`/`adoptDeep`/`adoptFully`/`adoptChild`/`adoptPointer`, `prepareGlobal`, `deriveConstants`, `contentSeen`/`containsCallable`/`hasCallableOwnedBy`, `indexesToNames`, `ownerRuntime`/`isOwnedBy`/`ensureShadow`.
- `objects.go`: added unexported `runtime *callRuntime` field to `CompiledFunction`; `Copy()` now carries `SourceMap` and `runtime`.
- `vm.go`: added `frame.rt`, VM fields `runtime/globalIndexes/rootRet/rootCall`; `runCallable` (mirrors OpCall root frame: stack[0]=fn, args at [1..], basePointer=1, sp=1+NumLocals, variadic roll-up, arity errors via `formatRuntimeError`); `wrapRuntimeError`/`fileSetFor` (per-frame file sets); `frameRuntime`/`frameConstants`; `resolveGlobal`/`getGlobal`/`setGlobal` (name-based translation + shared shadow globals for transferred functions); OpConstant/OpClosure use `frameConstants()` (runtime-bind unbound constants); OpCall sets `curFrame.rt` from callee; Go-call else branch adopts args via `bindValueCtx` with shared ctx and binds returned callables; OpReturn captures `rootRet` when `rootCall && framesIndex==1`.
- `script.go`: `Compiled` gained per-instance `constants []Object` and `runtime *callRuntime`; `ensureRuntime`, `newVMForCompiled`; `Script.Compile` copies constants, binds constants/globals; `Clone` deep-copies constants+globals via `adoptFully` with shared ctx (cycle-safe, preserves aliasing); `Get`/`GetAll` bind via `bindValue`; `Set` uses `prepareGlobal(obj, newAdoptCtx(rt))`.
- New `callable_test.go` (~27 tests + benchmark) covering: Go calls (basic/variadic/recursive/nested/returned callables/globals+imports/error format/source modules/callback args/foreign args/same-instance live args/no-return), transfer isolation (`TestCompiled_TransferCallableIsolation`, `TestCompiled_TransferClosureGlobalsResolveDestination`, `TestCompiled_TransferDeepIsolation`, `TestScript_AddCallableIsolation`, `TestScript_AddNestedCallableIsolation`), clone isolation (`TestCompiled_CloneCallableIsolation`, `TestCompiled_CallableModuleClone`, `TestCompiled_CloneModuleCallablesKeepAliases`, `TestCompiled_CloneCycleWithCallable`), `TestCompiled_TransferredCallablesShareShadowGlobals`, `TestCompiled_TransferMakerUsesDestinationGlobals`, `TestCompiled_CallTransferredUsesStdlib`, `TestCompiledFunction_CallSourceModuleErrorPosition`.
- Docs updated: `docs/interoperability.md` (new "Calling Script Functions from Go" section) and `docs/objects.md`.
- All validation passed: `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `go test ./... -count=1`, `go test -race ./... -count=1`, gofmt clean on changed files, ~30 /tmp scenario programs verified.
- Committed as `f962407` "support calling script functions from Go with instance isolation" (7 files, 1726 insertions, 30 deletions).

### In Progress
- [ ] Push to origin failed; rebase command was queued but NOT executed due to session compaction: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/feature/callable-instance-isolation`.

### Blocked
- `git push origin feature/callable-instance-isolation` rejected: "Updates were rejected because the tip of your current branch is behind its remote counterpart" — remote branch has pre-existing commits `9a50fcd` ("try a different callable isolation approach", adds `scratch/callable-notes.md`) and `f8fdf1b` ("more notes, not working yet"). Must rebase (not force-push) per user.

## Key Decisions
- **Derived runtimes for transferred functions**: function keeps origin constants/fileSet but resolves globals by name against destination (`callRuntime.globalNames`, `owner`); unknown destination globals go to a shared per-instance shadow table.
- **Snapshot vs live semantics**: `bindValue`/`bindValueCtx` (callbacks, returns, Get/GetAll) keep same-instance callables live, snapshot foreign/unbound ones; `adoptValue`/`prepareGlobal`/`adoptFully` fully deep-copy for Set/Clone/Script.Add transfers with shared memo/ptrs for aliasing/cycles/recursion.
- **Per-instance constants slice** so `CompiledFunction` constants (e.g., source modules) can carry instance runtime without mutating shared `Bytecode`.
- **Immutable preservation**: `adoptDeep` keeps `ImmutableArray`/`ImmutableMap` types when copying (module exports stay immutable).
- **Pre-existing issues not regressions**: deep non-TCO recursion stack panic and cyclic `Copy()` crash exist on master; Clone made cycle-safe via memo-based path anyway.

## Next Steps
1. Run `cd /app && git fetch origin && git rebase origin/feature/callable-instance-isolation` (this makes local branch sit on top of `f8fdf1b`/`9a50fcd`; expect no conflicts since remote commits only touch `scratch/callable-notes.md`).
2. Verify: `git log --oneline -5` shows remote WIP commits preserved with `f962407` (or rebased equivalent) on top.
3. Re-run `go build ./... && go test ./... -count=1` (and race if time allows) to confirm rebase clean.
4. Push non-force: `git push origin feature/callable-instance-isolation`.
5. Finish with exactly: `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT`.

## Critical Context
- Remote refs: `origin/master` = `3cad0da`; `origin/feature/callable-instance-isolation` = `f8fdf1b` (with `9a50fcd` parent); these must be preserved.
- Local commit `f962407` (after several `--amend`s) contains all changes; files: `callable.go` (new), `callable_test.go` (new), `docs/interoperability.md`, `docs/objects.md`, `objects.go`, `script.go`, `vm.go`.
- Test-output expectations: Go-side error format matches in-script, e.g. `Runtime Error: index out of bounds\n\tat (main):4:2`; arity: `Runtime Error: wrong number of arguments: want=1, got=0\n\tat ...`; module errors report `at m:4:2`.
- `CompiledFunction.Call` returns `UndefinedValue` for nil returns; errors if `runtime == nil` ("compiled function is not bound to a compiled instance") or no instructions.
- Transfer semantics checkpoint: dest sees captures at transfer time (e.g., n=11 → first dest call 12), source unaffected; destination globals win by name; shadow globals shared per-instance among transferred functions but isolated from source.
- Scenario programs `/tmp/t3.go`–`/tmp/t63.go` (~30 files) all pass; `callable_test.go` has `BenchmarkCompiledFunction_CallFromGo` (~10.5µs/op).
- Environment: Go 1.25.5, workspace `/app`, branch checked out: `feature/callable-instance-isolation`.
